sanskrit: ardharātre likhet stambhamākṛṣṭiṃ prāg dinodayātindre stambhanamuccāṭamagnau sarvābhicārakamkulotsādaṃ marudbhāge pakṣe kalahanigrahauvaśyākṛṣṭau likhed bhūrje likheduccāṭanaṃ dhvajepretacīre samālikhya tāpajvarādimāraṇamvaśyāṃ kuṅkumakarpūrarocanābhirharidrayāvidveṣaṇaṃ svaraktena kākaraktena māraṇamvidveṣoccāṭanaṃ kākapakṣeṇāpi ca māraṇamnirviṣīkaraṇe stambhe raktavarṇaṃ vicintayetpītaṃ stambhanakāryeṣu dhūmramuccāṭane smaretāsanaṃ śvetarūpaṃ tu sāttvikaṃ samudāhṛtamdaṇḍamānasthitaṃ raudraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ tāmasamucyatetāmasaṃ śatrunāśārthaṃ sarvavyādhinivāraṇamrudrāḥ satārkṣyagandharvayakṣarakṣohikinnarāḥsarveṣāmapi mantrāṇāmaṃśāḥ pañcadaśa smṛtāḥdvyakṣarī kartarī sūcī tryakṣarī caturakṣaraiḥkavacaḥ saptabhiḥ śūlaścāṣṭābhirnavabhiḥ paraḥcakraṃ dvādaśabhirvarṇaiḥ kuliśaṃ syāt trayodaśaiḥpadmaṃ ṣoḍaśabhirvarṇairmantracchede tu kartarīmuṣalaḥ kṣobhaṇe bandhe śṛṅkhalaḥ krakacacchidividveṣe paraśuṃ cakraṃ sarvakarmasu yojayetbhusuṇḍī māraṇe padmaṃ śāntipuṣṭyādikarmaṇikvacidevaṃ darśitaṃ tu tattvāgamavirodhi cayathākāmo japaḥ kāryo mantrāṇāmapi me śṛṇumāraṇe viṣasaṃhāre grahabhūtavinigrahe

sanskrit: mantrādau nāmasaṃsthānaṃ yoga ityabhidhīyatemohane dīpane yogaṃ prayuñjanti manīṣiṇaḥnāmna ādyantamadhyeṣu mantraḥ syādrodha ucyatejvaragrahaviṣādyārttiśāntike rodha ucyateekaikāntaritaṃ yattu grathanaṃ tat prakīrtitamtat saṃpuṭaṃ bhavettattu kīlane paribhāṣitammantrākṣarābhyāmekaikaṃ sādhyanāmākṣaraṃ kramātevaṃ yogakramaḥ proktaḥ sarvakārye manīṣibhiḥphaṭkāraṃ chedane hu/phaṭ vighnagrahanivāraṇepuṣṭau cāpyāyane vauṣaṭ bodhane sanikṛntatauśāntipuṣṭivaśadveṣākṛṣṭyuccāṭanamāraṇevaśyākarṣaṇasantāpajvare svāhā prayojayetvaṣaṭ sammohanoddīpapuṣṭimṛtyuñjayeṣu cauccāṭane ca vidveṣe vaṣaṭ cāgnikṛte vaṣaṭstrīpuṃnapuṃsakatvena tridhā syurmantrajātayaḥhuṃ phaṭ pumāṃsa ityuktā vaśyoccāṭanakarmasuśiṣṭaḥ saumyaḥ praśastau tau karmaṇoḥ krūrasomyayoḥmantraḥ śānto'pi raudratvaṃ hu/ phaṭ pallavito yadisvāpakālo vāmabāho jāgaro dakṣiṇāvahaḥprabodhakāle jānīyādubhayorubhayāvahamāgneyīṃ dhāraṇāṃ kṛtvā kuryādāveśanaṃ kramāttatraiva dakṣiṇe cittaṃ kṛtvā māraṇameva caādhāre dakṣiṇe bhāge viṣagrahasamāgamāttatraiva vāme kartavyo vyavahāraśca śatrutaḥbaindave dakṣiṇe bhāge sthāpya cittaṃ cared budhaḥ

sanskrit: ākarṣaṇe tu lavaṇaṃ priyaṅgu pauṣṭikoditaiḥkārpāsanimbaistakrādyairnavakeśaistathāpi vāunmattabījairjuhuyādviṣaraktena māraṇetanmāṃsañcāpi sādhyasya nakharomanarairapilaśunairasṛjābhyukṣya gardabhasya ca māraṇerohībījaistilopetairutsāde juhuyād yavaiḥsarṣapaistilasaṃmiśrairhunet sarvābhicārakemarīcaiḥ sarṣapaiḥ siddhairarkakṣīraiḥ kaṭudrumaiḥāyuḥkāmairghṛtatilairvābhirāmrapallavaiḥguḍūcī mṛtyujjayena tathā śāntau gajāśvayoḥvṛṣṭikāmo vaitasībhiḥ samidbhiḥ patrakaistathāghṛtagugguluhomena vākpatitvaṃ prajāyatepuṣpaiḥ sarasvatīsiddhistathā sarvārthasādhanamraktapuṣpairapāmārgairaṅkolaiśca subhadrakaiḥvātoddhūtaiḥ śuṣkapatraiḥ kāṣṭhairaśanipātitaiḥdūrvāguḍūcīgavyena sarpiṣā tilataṇḍulaiḥsutīrthe prajapenmantraṃ pūrvaṃ pāpavimuktayena dhyāto nārcito mantraḥ susiddho na prasīdatipūjāṃ dhyānaṃ japaṃ homaṃ yathā karmacatuṣṭayamjapasyāntaḥ śivaṃ dhyāyed dhyānasyāntaḥ punarjapaḥkāraskarakṣyāmalakodumbaro jambusaṃjñakaḥpalāśalakṣakāmbaṣṭhavilvārjunavikaṅkatāḥsabinduḥ saparākrāntastumburuśca tathā īśaḥkromaṅkuśaśca huṃ krodhaḥ i viṣṇuśca parāparaḥdvābhyāṃ vā bahubhiścaiva saṃyuktaḥ piṇḍa ucyate

sanskrit: jaṭhare nābhideśe ca liṅge guhye ca vinyasetevaṃ vinyasyadehastu dhyāyet pakṣiṃ śivātmakamvijñāpya bāhyayogena devaṃ santoṣya yatnataḥtāvacchataṃ tarpayitvā puraścaryā kṛtā bhavetkarmāṇi kuryādiṣṭāni mantreṇānena mantravitprāṇān pratiṣṭhāpya śataṃ tathāṣṭau japtvā dhṛtaṃ cet sa vaśaṃ prayātivaśyā nityaṃ pratyupadeśāddhāsyannarthān prārthitabhogānbhakṣyabhojyavidhiṣu pratiyojyaṃ sānvayāti vaśaṃ maraṇāntamdaṇḍaṃ vā puruṣasya taddhṛtamidaṃ vaśyāṅganā manmathaḥsaptarātraṃ kṣiped yasyā mūrdhni sā vaśagā bhavetrlipte vaśyamavaśyameva bhavitā cānyeṣu janmasvapidhārayati sarvaloke priyo bhavenniyatameva mantrivaraḥsamṛdā bhadrakariṣṇuḥ priyāśca musalīśamantrajāpenatathaivaikaṃ varaṇamūlanāya kā kathā manuṣyeṣuañjalyādi kramaśaḥ saṃyojya deśamakhilaṃ vaśyakaramsādhyāṃ śṛṅkhalayā kaṇṭhe badhvākarṣamanuṃ japetturīyakukkuṭasyānte sādhyanāma ca karma cayāmārabhya japedevaṃ yoṣitaṃ madanālasāmutsvinnaguhyajaghanā śithilāṃśukabhūṣaṇākāmānaloṣṇaniḥśvāsā śoṣitādharapallavāracitāñjalirāyāti mukhenāsyālayaṃ niśitaptaṃ dīpaśikhāgninā svayamamūrvaśyorvaśī cāśrayetnnākarṣatyacirādabhīṣṭavanitāṃ nāgādilokādapivahnau mattamataṅgavegaviṣamā yoṣā samāyāti catrisahasrañca tridinaṃ iṣṭamākarṣayed dhruvam

sanskrit: vairiprāṇān pratiṣṭhāpya yasmin gomayavāriṇidṛṣṭvā tāṃ gomayajale ripucchāyāṃ samāhitaḥtattadvinaśyati ripoḥ saptāhānnātra saṃśayaḥśirorogo bhavettasya braṇe śastreṇa mastakemandāradhūmamākandaṃ proktametadviṣaṃ budhaiḥvaṃśapippalanāgau rauhiṇanalinasamudrasārikāḥvañjulapanasārkaśamī kadambanimbaṃ prakāśamūlañcasa ramābhavanaṃ bhavejjapavidhau kapimāṃsīkusumaiḥsahasradhā yanmaheśamanuḥ kukkuṭamanurūpakaḥrāpūjyate bahuvidhairapi vatsareṇabhaktyā yaḥ prajapedupendramiva taṃ prāpnotvivānandayetdhyātvā manuṃ svaṃ nayano japed yo vidviṣṭamākhaṇḍalavat sametiprauḍhāṃ śriyaṃ bhṛśamavāpya ca ratnapūrṇāmgrīvaṃ yaḥ prajapedamuṣya bhavanaṃ dhānyādibhiḥ pūryatebhajatāṃ vaśīkaraṇamatīva ramākaramnaramāśu rakṣitadhūrjapānvitamso'sau kukkuṭahaṃsavad yuddheṣu codjeṣyatijeṣyati sapadi raṇe tān sabhaṭaiścaraṇāyudhaiḥacireṇa tasya bhavane bhajate vasatiṃ kamalā vimalāpraṇatasujanarakṣāvikṣatānāṃ svapakṣaḥsuravaranaranārīrañjanākṛṣṭidakṣaḥvāṃśaktiścātha puṃkolīyugalaṃ vigalaṃ tataḥkrodhaṃ taduddharenmantraṃ kukkuṭasya manoramamidānīṃ śrotumicchāmi devīmucchiṣṭapūrvikāmyasyā vijñānamātreṇa bhaved vidyāmayo naraḥ

sanskrit: kathyatāṃ deva yatnena rahasyena niveditamviṣaṃ ca sthāvaraṃ devi vidyābhāvān nihanti caucchiṣṭapūrvikāṃ caiva mātaṅgīṃ sarvasiddhidāmyayā vijñātayā devyā kṣayaṃ gacchanti cāpadaḥviṣaṃ jayati deveśi svaparāṅgasamāśritamsvargadā mokṣadā caiva rājyasaukhyaphalapradāsakṛduccāritā vidyā brahmahatyāviśodhinīyadyucchiṣṭamukho bhūtvā smaraddevīṃ kadācanadurbhagā subhagā nūnaṃ duḥkhitā sukhitā bhavetnirdhano dhanamāpnoti mūrkho vidyāmavāpnuyātvidhānañca pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu devi manoramebaliṃ dattvā prathamato mūlamantreṇa sādhakaḥmantraṃ śṛṇu mahādevi yathāvat kathayāmi tesumukhīti tato devi kīrtayettadanantaramnādabindusamāyuktaṃ ṭhakāratritayaṃ punaḥcaturviṃśatyakṣarīyaṃ vidyā sarvārthadāyinīnāṅganyāsakaranyāsau na varṇanyāsa īritaḥyasya tiṣṭhati mantro'yaṃ na sa vighnairavāpyateśavopari samāsīnāṃ raktāmbaraparicchadāmsuvaktrāṃ ṣoḍaśābdāṃ tu pīnonnatapayodharāmvāmadakṣiṇayogena dhyāyenmantraviduttamaḥucchiṣṭenaiva kartavyo japo'syāḥ siddhimicchatāaparañca pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu devi phalapradamsthaṇḍile maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā caturasraṃ samāhitaḥtato'gnerghyaṃ samādāya vahnirūpāṃ vyavasthitām

sanskrit: anenādibhirāhutyornirviṣaṃ yātyasaṃśayaḥgṛdhrakarṇāmanuṃ devi kathayāmi śṛṇu priyelambastanipadaṃ paścād mahoraripadaṃ vadetpadānyetāni vīpsāyai vadettanmantrameva caayutaṃ mantrasiddhyarthaṃ mātṛkānyāsatatparaḥsvayameva tu pañcāṅgabhadrakālī tu devatāpramattanayanā śūrā dīrghaghoṇā madānvitābhrukuṭyāgnīva saṃdīptā mahāvadanabhīṣaṇātriśūlairugradordaṇḍā narakīṭapalāśinīśiromālā vicitrāṅgī pibantī śoṇitāsavampiśācaskandhamāruhya bhramantī vasudhātalamitthaṃbhūtā bhadrakālī mātṛbhiḥ parivāritādhūmāvatyāśca yat proktamanayā ca tadācaretvijñāya taṃ tu nirghoṣamekasūtraṃ vanāntarātśūnyāgāre vane vāpi kuṇḍaṃ kṛtvā trikoṇakamtataḥ kuṇḍaṃ japenmantrī viṣavṛkṣasya sādhakaḥsuvinītaṃ dvijaṃ dhīraṃ kṛtvā cottarasākṣiṇamkṛtarakṣaḥ samārādhyo vahniḥ krodhasamanvitaḥdattvā siddhārthake mantrī juhuyāt savanadvayamhunet sahasradvayamatradhīmān visṛjya vahniṃ balidānapūrvakamśatrūṇāṃ saṅghamuccaiḥ karavidhṛtaśilādaṇḍanirghoṣaghoramgatvā dūreṇa visṛjet tataḥ krodhānale sthitaḥsnātvāvaśyaṃ śucirbhūtvā kaṇṭhamātrodake sthitaḥaṣṭottarasahasraṃ tu japedanyacchataṃ śatamgatvā tu mahatīṃ pūjāṃ kṛtvā devasya cakriṇaḥ

sanskrit: tāvajjaptvā ghaṭe sadbhirabhiṣiñcet svakaṃ vapuḥdhyātvā durgāṃ japellakṣaṃ sāvitrīñca tathaiva cadakṣiṇāṃ śaktito dattvā siddho bhavati sādhakaḥpurā devāsure yuddhe hareṇa kila nirmitaḥprayogamātraṃ tadvakṣye vidveṣoccāṭanādikammantraṃ japtvā sahasraṃ tat khanet pitṛvane budhaḥmānavānāṃ dvijaśreṣṭha na kartavyaṃ manīṣibhiḥdhūstūrabījakarṇena japtvā vālipya tatpadeśrūyatāṃ parameśāni sāvadhānā'vadhārayamahākāli padaṃ coktvā kilayugmamataḥ paramārādhya prajapennityamaṣṭottaraśataṃ manumdhyātavyeyaṃ mahādevo bhadrakālī bhayāpahādantairjambūphalābhaiḥ pariharatu bhayaṃ pātu māṃ bhadrakālīaśeṣakālikāmantraṃ kathitaṃ kāryasiddhayeyatheṣṭaceṣṭayā cintyā dharmakāmārthasiddhidāsarvasiddhipradaṃ sākṣānmahāpātakanāśanamgandhavairdānavairyakṣaiḥ svasvakāryārthasiddhayekāmibhirdharmibhiścārthalipsubhiḥ sevitāṃ sadāoṃ karālavadanāṃ ghorāṃ muktakeśīṃ caturbhujāmsadyaśchinnaśiraḥkhaḍgavāmādho'rdhvakarāmbujāmmahāmeghaprabhāṃ śyāmāṃ tathā caiva digambarāmkarṇāvataṃsatāṃ nītaśavayugmabhayānakāmśavānāṃ karasaṃghātaiḥ kṛtakāñcīṃ hasanmukhīmghorarūpāṃ mahāraudrīṃ śmaśānālayavāsinīmśavarūpamahādevahṛdayopari saṃsthitām

sanskrit: māhākālena ca samaṃ viparītaratāturāmevaṃ sañcitya kālīṃ tu śmaśānālayavāsinīmhū/ hū/ hrī/ svāhā)triguṇañca tataḥ kūrcayugmaṃ lajjāyugaṃ tataḥṭhadvayena samāyuktaṃ manumenaṃ vidurbudhāḥnātra śudhyādyapekṣāsti na vā mitrāridūṣaṇamna vittavyayabāhulyaṃ kāyakleśakaraṃ na catasya haste sadaivāsti sarvasiddhirna saṃśayaḥtasya darśanamātreṇa vādinaśca parājitāḥvahneḥ śaityaṃ jalastambhaṃ gatistambhaṃ vivasvataḥbrahmahatyā surāpānamagamyāgamanaṃ tathāvāgīśvarasamo vāci dhanairdhanapatirbhavetsarvasyeha janasyeha vallabhaḥ kīrtivarddhanaḥcandrasūryaprabho bhūtvā vaset kalpāyutaṃ divina tasya durlabhaṃ kiñcid yaḥ smared ghoradakṣiṇāmjaṭājūṭañca sañcintya mahākālīsamīpagāmevaṃ sañcintya devīṃ tu raktapuṣpaiḥ samarcayetsvaṃ svaṃ santyajya bharttāramāliṅgante sadaiva tammahākālasamīpasthāṃ dhyātvā pītaiḥ supuṣpakaiḥākarṣaṇaṃ bhavatyeva sadā sthāvarajaṅgamamākarṣayati sarvaṃ hi mahākālavaco yathādhyātvaivaṃ hi ca sarvasya cānte ca dvayameva himāraṇaṃ hi bhavatyasya yamuddiśya kṛtā kriyāvidrāvayati muktāsyā pronmattayati ghūrṇitāsaṃkocayati saṃkruddhā vipralabdhā virodhayet

sanskrit: atra sarvaṃ prakartavyaṃ bhāvamātraṃ vicintayetsnātaḥ śuklāmbaradharaḥ kṛtanityakriyo divāathavā muktakeśaśca tena syuḥ sarvasiddhayaḥnagnāṃ parastriyaṃ vīkṣan prajapedayutaṃ naraḥtasya darśanamātreṇa vādino niṣprabhā matāḥathavā muktakeśaśca haviṣyaṃ bhakṣayennaraḥaṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā bhāgamāmantraṇena casarvavidyāvatāṃ śreṣṭho bhavedvai nātra saṃśayaḥbāliśasyāpi tadvāṇī gadyapadyamayī bhavetsurateṣu sadā japyaṃ mahāpātakamuktayejapedayutasaṃkhyaṃ tu sarvakāmārthasiddhayeayutaṃ vāgyato bhūtvā bibhīṣikaparāyaṇaḥākarṣaṇaṃ vaśīkāroccāṭanaṃ bodhanaṃ tathāvāgmitvañca dhanitvañca bahuputritvameva casamāyāti khecaratvaṃ devatvamapi caiva hina bhītirna manuṣyasya na ca vāk kāyapātanamsvadeharudhirāktaiśca vilvapatraiḥ sahasraśaḥretoyuktena puṣpeṇa arkasyeha sahasraśaḥdhanavān balavān vāgmī sarvayoṣitpriyaḥ sudhīḥśmaśāne yoṣitaṃ nītvā suvastrāṃ gaṇikāṃ tathājavāpuṣpirmanuṃ prokṣya tato dhyāyettu caṇḍikāmśmaśānaśayane caiva śavāsanagataḥ punaḥretobhiśca tathā tadvat svakīyena kacena cameṣamāhiṣaraktena nararaktena caiva highanitvaṃ jāyate tasya sarvasiddhiḥ prajāyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00190 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ājñayā devarājo'pi rūpeṇāpi manobhavaḥsādhitā sādhitaṃ māṃsaṃ sāsthi dadyāt sadā balimśavasyāsthi pradātavyaṃ tathā madyasamanvitamnivedayet śmaśāne tat sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavetpratyekaṃ prajapenmantraṃ tatastaddhomayed budhaḥhastavistārataḥ kṛtvā hastañcāpi tathāpyadhaḥmahākālāya devāya pradadyāt prathamāhutimkṛṣṇapuṣpeṇa sājyena retasāpi viśeṣataḥāmiṣādikamapyevaṃ juhuyāt pitṛkānanedivā caiva prakartavyaṃ sarvakāmārthasiddhayeprakarttavyaṃ prayatnena sarvakāmārthasiddhayeśūdrāṇāñca tathā proktaṃ rātrau dṛṣṭaṃ mahāmatammahākālaṃ hunedyatnāt paścāddevīṃ prayatnataḥmāṃsaṃ raktaṃ tvacaṃ keśaṃ nakhaṃ bhaktañca pāyasamevaṃ kṛtvā vidhātavyaṃ labhate siddhimuttamāmsadā hutvā samāpnoti nityamevamatandritaḥtrikoṇaṃ vinyaset pūrvaṃ punaḥ paścāt trikoṇakamevaṃ pañcadaśāraṃ vai rekhābhiḥ pariveṣṭayettataḥ pūrvādikoṇeṣu vāmāvartena vinyasetvipracittāṃ tu vinyasya bahiḥ ṣaṭkoṇake punaḥnīlāṃ ghanāṃ balākāñca tathaivāparake trikesarvāḥ śyāmā asikarā muṇḍamālāvibhūṣitāḥtadvahirmūlataścāpi brāhmī nārāyaṇī tathāvārāhī ca tathā pūjyā nārasiṃhī tathaiva camahākālañca tathaiva nyaseccaiṣa vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00190 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: anulepanakaṃ cāpi vibhavenopakalpitamaṅganyāsakaranyāsau yathāvat kathayāmyahamṣaḍaṅgāni nyasenmantrī triḥ sakṛd vā yathāsukhamtathā jaṅghādvayañcaiva yojanīyaṃ diśo daśasamastāṅgaṃ prakurvīta śodhitaṃ mantravittamaḥyoginīcakrasahitāṃ mahākālasamanvitāmbalimutthāpya naivedyaṃ nai-ṛtyāñca nivedayetnirmālyaṃ vai śucau deśe dhāraṇīyaṃ prayatnataḥaśuciśca tathā rātrau lakṣamekaṃ tathaiva cahome'pi tarpaṇe caiva yathāvat kathito vidhiḥstaṃ taṃ prāpya prayāti pratipadapadavīṃ yogibhiḥ prārthanīyāmśmaśānakālikā devī krīṃbījaṃ hū/ ca śaktikaḥvakṣaḥsthale samāsīnā pṛcchati sma nagātmajākāṃ vidyāṃ prāpya kavayo bhāratādīn pracakrireprāha priyāṃ pariṣvajya sādhu sādhviti pūjayanyāmavāpya mahātmāno dharmakāmārthamuktiṣuvāde vadasi yāṃ vākyastambhinīṃ prativādinīmhāsyāya yā sadasyānāmaśuddhajalpanādinājñānamātreṇa mantrasya matirugrā prajāyatejihvāyāṃ nyasanādeva mūrkho'pi sukavirbhavetjāḍyaṃ nyasya kapālake trijagatāṃ hantyugratārā svayammahācīnakramāṃ natvā tārāṃ tribhavatāriṇīmsarva eva śubhaḥ kālo nāśubho vidyate kvacitvastrāsanasthānagehadehasparśādivāriṇaḥnātra siddhādyapekṣāsti na vā mitrādidūṣaṇam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00190 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gadyapadyamayī vāṇī sabhāyāṃ tasya jāyaterājāno'pi ca dāsatvaṃ bhajante kiṃ pare janāḥmahāniśi śucau deśe baliṃ mantreṇa dāpayetjapasthāne mahāśaṅkhaṃ niveśyordhvaṃ japañcaretupahāraṃ yathāyogyaṃ bhakṣyadravyān yathārucīnbhaktādyaśeṣabhakṣyāṇi dattvā bhakṣan japañcaretjape na kālaniyamo nārcādiṣu baliṣvapinādharmo jāyate tena kiñcid dharmo mahān bhavetkṛtārthaṃ manyamānastu santuṣṭanijamānasaḥvilvairmaruvakādyaiśca tulasīvarjitaiḥ śubhaiḥtatrasthaṃ sādhayed yogī tārāṃ tribhavatāriṇīmgobhūhiraṇyavastrādyairyathāvibhavavistaraiḥviṣṭareṣu samāśritya sādhayet siddhimuttamāmnirlepaṃ nirmalaṃ śuddhamātmānaṃ tāriṇīmayambhūyastasyopari dhyāyet ṭāṃkārāt śvetapaṅkajamtato hukārajāṃ paśyet kartṛkāṃ bījabhūṣitāmpratyālīḍhapadāṃ ghorāṃ muṇḍamālāvibhūṣitāmnavayauvanasampannāṃ pañcamudrāvibhūṣitāmcaturbhujāṃ lalajjihvāṃ bhīmarūpāṃ varapradāmpiṅgograikajaṭāṃ dhyāyed maulāvakṣobhyabhūṣitāmyonimudreti vikhyātā pañcamudrā namaskṛtāsāveśasmeravadanāṃ stryalaṅkāravibhūṣitāmbhāvanārasasampanno bhaved yogī mahākaviḥlabhate'bhimatāṃ vāṇīṃ mantrasya lakṣajāpataḥpañcaraśmisamāyukto'pyajñānendhanadāhakaḥ

sanskrit: prathamaṃ saparaṃ dattvā caturthasvarabhūṣitamstṛṃkārañca tato dadyāt caturthasvarabhūṣitamphaṭkāraṃ tu tato dadyāt sampūrṇaṃ siddhimantrakamajasrabhāvanābhyāsād bhaved devo na saṃśayaḥbhavati cirāya sarasvatīnivāsaḥnijakulatilakāya jyeṣṭhaputrāya dadyātgurubhaktāya śāntāya dadyāt pātre dayātmaneputrāya kimathānyasmai vigotrāya supauruṣamna paṭhati cennāsya mūrkhatā bhavatibhavati jagati vādidvaitasiddhāntahantātena vīryavatī vidyā nirvīryā syāt prakāśanāttasmānmanyeta satataṃ piturapyadhikaṃ gurumtrilokyāṃ bhavati khyāto vidhāyāsya ca pūjanamniyataṃ labhate vyatyayamapi sadasatkarmaṇorubhayoḥjñātavyā viduṣā siddhirasya mantrasya lābhataḥacirādīhitā siddhirmahāśaṅkhasya mālayākṛtārthastena jāyeta svargaṃ vā mokṣameva vāśuddhacitto bhavennityaṃ siddhiḥ syādapavargadārājānaṃ japamātreṇa balinā sakalaṃ jagatbrahmaṇā pūrvamasmabhyaṃ mayā tubhyaṃ nagātmajekaraṃ datvā diśatyāśu so'pi ślokān karotyutaanāsthā ca dvitīyaṃ tu na kiñcid vighnakāraṇamviśeṣataḥ kaliyuge matprasādād bhaviṣyativācaspatirivācāryaṃ paśyanmantrajñamīdṛśamtātkālikī ca kavitā parairanabhibhāvitā

sanskrit: asūyakāya māṃ mā dāstathā syāṃ vīryavattamātasmai māṃ brūhi viprāya nidhipāyāpramādinesvagotre pauruṣaṃ naitadanyagotraṃ nayet sudhīḥsa vāsaḥ śrīsarasvatyoryatra sārasvato manuḥdantenānīya tat tūrṇaṃ kīlakaṃ tena kārayetlikhed vajrāvalīmadhye mūlamantrañca siddhidamsahasraṃ kṣīranīrāktaṃ padmānāṃ lohitatviṣāmmahāpadme padaṃ brūyāt padmāvati padaṃ tataḥevaṃ yaḥ kuru karma sa syād drutakavirdhruvampraṇavaṃ pūrvamuddhṛtya hṛllekhāṃ ca tataḥ paramyakṣādhipadamābhāṣya pataye padato mamagṛhṇāpaya dvidhā coktvā mama sarvapadāntataḥdvidhākṛṣyeti ca brūyāt truṭaṃ chindhīti ca dvidhāmāyāsvāheti mantro'yaṃ balyādau vṛddhisiddhitaḥathavā madhulājābhyāṃ jihvāyāṃ bālakasya tumūlamantraṃ likhenmantrī yasyoṣṭhe śvetadūrvayāśatābhijaptamātreṇa rocanātilako naraḥśmaśānāṅgāramādāya maṅgale vāsare niśiśatābhimantritaṃ tacca prakṣipedarimandirenarāsthini likhenmantraṃ kṣārayuktaharidrayākṣipyate yasya gehe tu mṛtyustasya trimāsataḥyoniyugme likhed bhūrje lākṣārasena mantravitsvarān kramagatāṃścāpi kādivarṇān yathākramamveṣṭitaṃ pītavastreṇa yatnena pariveṣṭayetstrīṇāṃ vāmakare bandhamanyeṣāṃ dakṣiṇe kare
source_edition: Muktabodha M00190 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: iyaṃ rakṣā purā baddhā jñānārthaṃ gotamādibhiḥrdrutatarakavitāyai yatnamanyaṃ tyajeccaādau jalamadhiṣṭhāya pādayoḥ kṣālanaṃ tataḥvighnānutsādayitvā tu kuryād bhūmyabhimantraṇammṛdvāsanaṃ samadhyāsya māyāṃ pūrvadale likhetmadhye bījaṃ likhettāraṃ bhūtaśuddhiṃ samācaretśuṣkaṃ pāpātmakaṃ dehaṃ dagdhaṃ sañcintayettataḥbhasma protsāritaṃ dhyātvā lalāṭe cintayettataḥtadasthiplāvitaṃ kṛtvā tatrātmānaṃ vicintayetviśvavyāpakatoyāntāṃ bījotthabījakarṇikāmmahodarīmīḍeṣaḍdīrghāḍhyena bījena pāṇyaṅgapūjanaṃ tataḥśrīmadekajaṭe caiva vajrapuṣpamityabhidhāya cadattvā gandhādikamapi baliyuktaṃ nivedayetpraṇavādyagnijāyāntaṃ vajrapuṣpaṃ viniṣipetasitābhaṃ yajenmantrī dikṣvaindrītaścaturdalevahnyādiṣu catuṣkoṇe svaiḥ svairmantrairyajet kramātvighnāntakaṃ samabhyarcya pūjayennarakāntakambaliṃ dattvā namaskṛtya stutvā devīṃ visarjayetbhūpuraṃ bahuratnāḍhyaṃ yantramekajaṭātmakamtattadakṣayatāṃ yāti tārādevyāḥ prasādataḥtārādivahnijāyāntamudīrya yajanaṃ caretyasya vijñānamātreṇa nāsādhyaṃ vartate bhuvinādabindusamāyuktāvevaṃ krodhadvayaṃ punaḥcaturdaśākṣarī proktā mahākālī dhruvādikā

sanskrit: haradvayaṃ stambhayugmaṃ kīlayadvayamuddharetnyāsaśuddhīnṛṣyādīṃśca nātra kāryā vicāraṇābrahmādidikṣu dūtībhiryuktāḥ saṃpūjya bhaktitaḥśaktiśūladhanurbāṇakhaḍgakheṭavarābhayāmardhacandrāṃ jaṭāyuktāṃ jihvālalanabhīṣaṇāmmattavyālopavītāṅgī bhūtavetālaveṣṭitāmdhyātvaivaṃ siddhidaṃ sādhyaṃ sādhayenmanasi sthitamvārāhī ca tathaivaindrī cāmuṇḍā caṇḍikāṣṭamīkarṇikāyāṃ tato devī mahākālabhayāpahājuhuyādvairiṇaṃ kruddho devīmantraṃ japan yathāharaṃ viṣaṃ rājiṇṭhañca kakajālavalānvitāsaptāhād vairiṇaṃ hanti kālikāmantrayogataḥdakṣiṇasyāṃ diśi sthitvā grāmaderdakṣiṇāmukhaḥyasya vijñānamātreṇa nāsādhyaṃ bhuvanatrayebhuvanabhayaṅkarīpadaṃ varmāntamuccarenmanumhṛdayañca tato'rdhena varmāstreṇa śiraḥ kramātaṅgirāśca ṛṣirdevī gāyatrīcchanda īritammahākṛtvā devatā cetyuktvā nyāsaṃ samācaretdaṃṣṭrākarālavadanāṃ trinetrāṃ sarvatojjvalāmtriśūlacakramuṣalakhaṭvāṅgakarapaṅkajāmdhyātvā kṛtyāṃ vidhānena pūjayenmantravittamaḥkṛṣṇaṃ māraṇakāryeṣu māṃsaraktāsavaistathābhīṣaṇāṃ śrīmatīṃ caiva pratiṣṭhāñca tathā parāmpūrve tu śāṅkarī nāma śuklavarṇāmbarānvitāmdakṣiṇe bhiṣikāṃ nāma lalajjihvāṃ sudhāmukhīm

sanskrit: caturbhujāṃ siṃhanādajvalacchūlakapālinīmpaścime vāruṇīṃ nāma svarṇavarṇāṃ hasanmukhīmuttare bhīmikāṃ nāma caturvargabhayaṅkarīmathāsyā viniyogastu kartavyo mantriṇā sadādvādaśāṅgulataḥ śatrornakhalomasamanvitamamuṣya prāṇā iha cāmuṣya jīva iha sthitaḥiti prāṇaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya maricaiḥ pratimāṃ lepayettataḥbadadhvā kāraskaramaye toraṇe vāpyadhomukhītatra sāyaṃ vidhāyāgniṃ paristīrya śaraistṛṇaiḥjuhuyānniculairlājaiḥ kākolūkasya picchakaiḥaṣṭottaraśatenaiva manujo juhuyāttataḥyo'yaṃ me kaṇṭhagraho'tidūrastho vāntike'pi casaṃrakṣyāgniṃ vidhānena navarātraṃ samācaretjale saṃloḍya mantreṇa ripuṃ dhyātvā niruddhadṛkvajraṃ śūlamidaṃ dhyātvā tasyopari vinikṣipetharasiddhe citāvahnau tailasiktairvibhītakaiḥripoḥ pratikṛtiṃ kṛtvā sādhyakṣaphalake'malephaṭkāraṃ hṛdaye kṛtvā śivanirmālyakūpakesadyo'vagāhanaṃ kṛtvā kuryādasyānurakṣaṇamṣaṇmāsān mriyate śatruḥ sandhyayorubhayorapigṛhītvā ca likhenmantrī kṛṣṇasarpasya śoṇitaiḥuṣṭrāsthinā citāṅgāraiḥ śatroruccāṭanaṃ bhavetannaiḥ samidbhiḥ pālāśaiḥ śāntiṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥvajrapuṣpairapāmārgairaṅgāraiśca subhadrakaiḥuktamauśanase tantre vāramasyāpi kathyate

sanskrit: mahāvyādhipraśamanaṃ nityamaṣṭādhikaṃ śatammanasā cintayet kṛtyāṃ gajārūḍhāṃ vitandritāmsakṛcchravaṇamātreṇa sarvapāpavināśanammedhāvī ca bhavedvāgmī tāvajjaptvābhiṣekataḥmāsaṃ pakṣaṃ dvimāsaṃ vā ṣaṇmāsaṃ vatsaraṃ tathāatha vakṣye viśeṣeṇa mahāśāntividhikramamsarvagrahādidoṣāṇāṃ nāśanaṃ siddhikāraṇamakālamṛtyumathanaṃ sadā vijayavardhanamputradaṃ kīrtidaṃ caiva alakṣmīmalanāśanamyoginībhūtavetālāḥ pretakuṣmāṇḍapannagāḥkṛtyāmabhyarcayed vatse yathāvidhipuraḥsaramtanmadhye'ṣṭadalaṃ likhya pakārādīn nyaset kramātcandrabimbaṃ likhenmadhye tasyordhve pratimāṃ likhettasya madhye nyaset kṛtyāṃ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutāmparito'ṣṭaghaṭe nyasyā asitāṅgādibhairavāḥkapālī bhīṣaṇaścaiva saṃhāraścāṣṭamaḥ smṛtaḥlokeśāntaṃ yajeddevīṃ tadagre homamācaretdūrvāgrakhadirāśvatthaṃ pratyekaṃ tu śatāṣṭakamtasya dakṣiṇapārśve tu lakṣmīṃ dhyāyedyathāvidhivāmapārśve yajed devīṃ hṛllekhāṃ bhuvaneśvarīmayutaṃ mūlamantraṃ tu japenmṛtyuvināśanammahāvyādhipraśamanaṃ tāvajjaptvābhiṣekataḥyena jñātaṃ parimalaṃ yasya vaktre sthitaṃ sadāityādibahule tantre jñeyaḥ parimalo manuḥsāvitryā saṃpuṭīkṛtya durgābījaṃ samaṃ nyaset

sanskrit: ātmano vā parasyāpi rogādiparipīḍitaḥdhānyahomād bhaved dhānyaṃ payasā paśulābhakṛtādityamaṇḍalādagre yat kṛtvā bhuvi rodhaśaḥjānudaghne jale tiṣṭhan dhyāyed vahnimayaṃ jalamprajvālya hastaṃ hṛdayaṃ śataṃ padmādibhiḥ spṛśetādityamaṇḍalādhastādagnināpo vidarbhitamdhyātaḥ śatrurvicāryaitannātra kāryā vicāraṇāratnālaṅkārapūrāṃ paramaśivavadhūmabhravarṇāṃ trinetrāmathātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi jayadurgāmanuṃ priyedurge durge padaṃ coktvā rakṣaṇīti padaṃ tataḥpātimadhyagataṃ kṛtvā nyaset mantrapadaṃ budhaḥśyāmāṃ trilocanāṃ dhyātvā hyātmānaṃ ca caturbhujāmyuddhe ca vyavahārādau jayādau tajjapennaraḥjayadurgāmanuḥ proktaḥ kathyate cāparo manuḥgṛdhragaṇaparivṛte dviṭhastārādirīritaḥjvālāmālini ca śikhāgṛdhragaṇaparivṛte tataḥayutaṃ niyutaṃ caitat japenmantraṃ japājjayīmantrāntaraṃ samākhyātaṃ jvālāmukhyā manūttamaḥjapedaṣṭasahasraṃ tu trayoviṃśativāsarānnārāyaṇīye kathitamagastyena purā punaḥsusiddhimicchatā gopyā nāmnāpi na samīrayetnavadurgāvidhānena darśayet kāryagauravātbhaktyā sannihitaṃ kuryādrakṣārthaṃ nityamādarāttato mantrī prayatnena prakuryānmāraṇakriyāmnivedya vidhivat paścāt mantrivaryeṇa nirdahet

sanskrit: pradadyāt dakṣiṇāṃ tasmai sahasraṃ śatameva vāsarvaśāntimavāpnoti sarvarakṣākṛtirbhavettadvat karmāṇi kurvīta nātra kāryā vicāraṇājvālāmukhīṃ bhīmarūpāṃ dhyāyet trailokyabhītidāmmārīciḥ kāśyapaḥ prokto manurasya mahāmanoḥnavabhiḥ saptabhiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ saptabhiḥ punaraṣṭabhiḥsa naḥ pariṣadati durgāṇi viśvānāveva sindhuṃ duritātyagniḥkaṭyandhunābhiṣu hṛdi stanayoḥ pāśvayodvayoḥprakūrparaprakoṣṭheṣu maṇibandhataleṣu cakrameṇa vinyased varṇān vidvān mantrasamudbhavānsakaṇṭhabāhuhṛtkukṣikaṭiguhyorujānuṣubibhrāṇāmanalātmikāṃ śaśidharāṃ durgāṃ trinetrāṃ smarettadante tilasiddhārthacitramūlaiḥ samidvaraiḥcatuścatvāriṃśadāḍhyaṃ catuśśatasamanvitammaṇḍale sarvatobhadre ṣaṭkoṇāṅkitakarṇikesumukhīṃ durmukhīṃ saṃjñāṃ paścād vyāghramukhīṃ punaḥāsanaṃ siṃhamantreṇa dadyāduktena deśikaḥ(sarvavidyāmayī brahmavidyāmannapūrṇāntargatāmucyate)śryādipādāṣṭakotpannā mūrtayo'rcyā bahiḥ punaḥaśvodarajasaṃjño'nyaḥ punarvaiśvānarāhvayaḥtato bhūsalilāgnivāyvathānantanamo'nvitāntataśca pūrvādidikṣu pṛthivyādicatuṣṭayamkalācatuṣṭayaṃ koṇeṣu saṃpūjya yathāvidhijāgatā tapanī vedagarbhā dahanarūpiṇīvāgīśvarī madavahā somarūpā manojavā

sanskrit: toyātmikā punarnityā dayāvatyapahāriṇīsamārādhyā nandanī ca parā viśvavimardinīniravadyā viśālākṣī śvāsodvāhā ca nādinīdhuryā durviṣahā paścādadrijā tāpahāriṇīlokapālāṃstathā'bhyarcet brajādyāyudhasaṃyutānāgneyāstrādhikarī syāt tadvidhānamudīryatepūrvoktā eva ṛṣyādyā mantrasya parikīrtitāḥmantranyāsapadanyāsau vidadhyāt pratilomataḥpūrvavajjapakḷptiḥ syād juhuyāt pūrvasaṃkhyayāarcanaṃ pūrvavat kuryāt tat śaktīḥ pratilomataḥkrūrakarmāṇi kurvīta pratilomavidhānataḥprayogakāle prajapedaṣṭau pādān vilomataḥśryādiḥ pañcākṣaraḥ pādo jñeyo jñānendriyātmakaḥcādyastṛtīyaḥ pañcārṇaḥ pañcabhūtamayaḥ smṛtaḥdaḥ pūrvaḥ pañcamaḥ pāda ūrmirūpaḥ ṣaḍakṣaraḥsopūrvaḥ pañcavarṇo'nyaḥ śabdādimaya īritaḥevaṃ tattvasamāyogāt pādakḷptirudāhṛtāpradhānamūrtipratimāḥ svasvavarṇoṃditaprabhāḥdevatā indriyotpannā ūrdhvadṛṣṭaya īritāḥdhāturūpākṣarotpannā udayānalaśobhitāḥetāḥ sarvāḥ smṛtāḥ klībā indriyārthodbhavāḥ striyaḥsvābhimukhyaḥ smṛtāḥ saumye parāṅmukhyo'nyakarmaṇiyābhirmantrī dahet śatroḥ rājyaṃ sagirikānanamāsureṣu prayuñjīta devatāsu ca saṃharetimāni mānuṣāṇyāhurnakṣatrāṇi manīṣiṇaḥ

sanskrit: citrā maghā viśākhāḥ syustārā rākṣasadevatāḥanurādhā mṛgaśiraḥ śravaṇaṃ devatārakāḥupakrameta nandāsu riktāsvastraṃ visarjayetupakramo bhaumavāre śanivāre visarjanamsthireṣu rāśiṣvārambhaścareṣu ca visarjanamkṛṣṇapakṣe'nalenāstraṃ visṛjecchaśinā punaḥbhānunā mokṣasaṃhārau kuryāt pakṣadvaye sudhīḥnakṣatravṛkṣasakalān sādhyākhyān karmasaṃyutānjuhuyādedhite vahnau mārayedripumātmanaḥdhustūraviṣavṛkṣākhyabhūruhotthān samidvarānjuhuyāt saṃyato bhūtvā ripuryamapuraṃ vrajetārdravastro vṛṣṭikāle maricairmadhunā'munātālapatre samālikhya śatrunāma yathāvidhijuhuyānmaricaiḥ kruddho jvarākrāntaḥ sa jāyatepiṣṭvā'pāmārgabījāni maricaṃ madhusaṃyutamṛkṣavṛkṣapratikṛterhṛdaye vadane nasiāgneyamuccared mantraṃ so'cirāt jvarito bhavettīkṣṇasnehena saṃlliptāṃ śatroḥ pratikṛtiṃ niśijvareṇa bādhyate sadyo homādasya mṛtirbhavedkvathite puttalīṃ sādhya nakṣatratarunirmitāmtacchirastāḍanaṃ kuryād japedastraṃ vilomataḥādityarathanāgendragrastīkṛtaviṣāhatamadhomukhaṃ nijaripuṃ dhyātvā kvāthitavariṇābibhrantīṃ musalaṃ śūlaṃ dhyāyet kālaghanaprabhāmhutvā vidveṣayet śatrūn mantreṇānena deśikaḥ

sanskrit: mahiṣīghṛtasaṃyuktaiḥ pallavairviṣavṛkṣajaiḥdhyātvā devīṃ purā proktāṃ caturbhirmaricādibhiḥriporuccāṭanaṃ kuryāt senāyā nātra saṃśayaḥdhyātvā sarṣapatailāktaibījairdhustūrasambhavaiḥkālājjananibhāṃ durgāṃ śūlakhaḍgadharāṃ smaretsamidvaraiḥ prajuhuyāt hanyānmāsena vairiṇamśarān kārmukanirmuktān vahnijvālāmukhākulānbhānubimbaṃ samālokya riporuccāṭanaṃ bhavetatidurgāmayomuṣṭiṃ gadāhastāṃ vicintayetpulākairjuhuyād nimbavibhītakasamidvaraiḥloṇaiḥ samadhuraiḥ sādhyavṛkṣakāṣṭhaidhite'nalepāśāṅkuśadharāṃ raktāṃ viśvadurgāṃ vicintayetjuhuyānniśi yo mantrī tasya viśvaṃ vaśaṃ bhavetpāśāṅkuśadharāṃ dhyātvā sindhudurgāṃ samidvaraiḥkapālaṃ triśikhaṃ pāśamaṅkuśaṃ bibhratīṃ karaiḥhutvā lavaṇaputtalyā madhuratrayayuktayāatidurgāṇi ityādyā yadarṇāstridhurīritāḥvindvādyānyakṣarāntā sā viśvadurgā prakīrtitātāṃ tāmagnyādikāmenāmagnidurgāṃ vidurbudhāḥdevīmabhyarcayennityaṃ prāguktenaiva vartmanākṛtyārogabhayadrohabhūtārīn nāśayedayamsthitvā tasyāgrato mantrī japenmantramananyadhīḥlavaṇairmadhunā siktairjuhuyāt paścimāmukhaḥśālīn prakṣālya saṃśodhya śuddhān kurvīta taṇḍulāncaruṃ pacet japed mantramavatārya punaḥ sudhīḥ

sanskrit: juhuyāt caruṇānena sājyenāṣṭasahasrakamśiṣṭaṃ tannikhaned dvāri saṃpātaṃ prāṅgaṇāntareparairutpāditā kṛtyā punastāneva bhakṣayetājyairmadhutrayopetairetairdaśaśataṃ pṛthakbhāskare meṣarāśisthe mantrajño'nuguṇe dineuddhṛtyādāya sikatāḥ saṃśodhya pariśodhayetbharjayenmanunā siddhyai darvyā brahmatarūtthayāviśākhākṛttikāmūlāhastottaramaghāsu cavihāyā'nyeṣu kurvīta sikatasthāpanaṃ sudhīḥprasthāḍhakaghaṭonmānānmadhyādiṣvavaṭeṣvathamadhyādidevīmantrāṇi kapālāntāni deśikaḥkapālaṃ svasvamantreṇa saṃpūjyānte baliṃ haretvihitā yatra rakṣeyaṃ varddhante tatra saṃpadaḥamunā vilayaṃ yānti vidhinā nātra saṃśayaḥpañcagavyayutaṃ pātre brahmavṛkṣavinirmitedine dine pravarddhante kālavṛṣṭyādibhiḥ sahapañcagavyāśanaṃ kuryāt sthāpanaṃ vidhinā'munāājyāt saptaguṇaṃ kṣīraṃ gomūtrāt triguṇaṃ dadhigāvaḥ syuḥ kapilaśvetahimadhūmāruṇaprabhāḥekonapañcāśat koṣṭhe phalake brahmaśākhinaḥ |likhitvā madhyakoṣṭheṣu pūjayet tatra devatāḥdadyādvaliṃ yathāpūrvaṃ asya pūrvoditaṃ phalambhūbimbasthaṃ sarvabhūtāmayaghnaṃ rakṣāyuḥśrīkīrtidaṃ yantrametatyaḥ pumān guruṇā śiṣṭastasyādhīnaṃ jagattrayamevaṃ śabdasya śaktiḥ syāt jāvavedāstathā smṛtaḥ

sanskrit: vahnirūpeṇa tiṣṭhantaṃ paramātmānamavyayamputrādakṣādikān sarvān samyagjñānaṃ tathaiva cayaḥ samyak sarvalokānāṃ śatrutvaṃ samyagācaretvyapohatu mahādevaḥ puruṣārthavibodhanaḥpuraskriyāyutaṃ cāsya daśāṃśaṃ ghṛtahomataḥiṣṭasiddhimavāpnoti bhayaṃ cāśu vinaśyatisarvadurgeṣu yo nityaṃ smarenmantramatandritaḥdhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyamārogyaṃ puṣṭivarddhanamdurgāgāraṃ samāśritya sādhayanti manīṣiṇaḥpūjitā vidhinā sā ca sarvamiṣṭaṃ prayacchatiapāmārgaśataṃ hutvā goṣṭhe śāntikarī bhavetdurgamārge bhaye dyūte vyavahāre jale raṇejapamātreṇa viprāṇāṃ sarvaṃ saṃsādhayet yathāyamuddiśya japedviprastattadāpnotyasaṃśayamyāvadastamanaṃ vipraḥ sarvān kāmānavāpnuyātādityamaṇḍalāsīnāṃ durgāṃ durgaharāṃ śivāmcaturbhujāṃ trinetrāṃ ca raktābhāṃ jātavedasīmāsyadaghne jale sthitvā japettadgatamānasaḥmahadbhiḥ pātakaiḥ sarvaiḥ pātakairupapātakaiḥjalasya maṇḍale mantrī juhuyādanayā jalamsuvarṇaṃ labhate mantrī sadyo ratnān svarūpataḥdevyā'bhiṣicyamāno'haṃ yatnairapi vicintayetāyurārogyamaiśvaryaṃ śatrunāśaṃ jalaṃ ca yamprabhūtairindhanairagniṃ sthāpya prajvālya vāgyataḥprācyāmagnimahādurgāṃ mantrāṇāmadhidevatām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00190 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śaṅkhaṃ cakraṃ dhanuścāpaṃ dadhatīṃ mṛtyutarjanīmpavitrāṃ siṃhādhirūḍhāṃ gāyatrīṃ kumārīṃ japetsiddhyanti sarvakaryāṇi vinaśyanti bhayāni caāyurārogyakāmastu samādhāya hutāśanamhuned durgāṃ pārṣadāya tathaikaikāhutiṃ kramāttilena juhuyādājyaṃ vyāhṛtibhistataḥ paramtadagne juhuyānmantrī sarvagrahaṃ vinaśyatiudumbarastathā plakṣo vṛkṣāṇāṃ krama īritaḥmadhvaktaistu tathā sarvairvaśyāḥ syurmaraṇāntikamtathā varṇāśca catvāro vaśyāḥ syuśca yathākramamchittvā paraśunā bhittvā pañcadhā taṃ krameṇa tuudīcyaṃśaśca sandhyādau māsapakṣadinaṃ tataḥpañcagavyena saṃgṛhya svaisvairmantrairvidhānataḥevameva krameṇaiva mantrayecca śataṃ śatamabhyarcya devadeveśīṃ manunānena bhaktitaḥagrahārapurakṣetragṛhavaprādiṣu kramātpañcagavyaṃ vinikṣipya tathā śaṅkhādi vinyasetdhyāyet samantato durgāṃ siṃhārūḍhāṃ yathāvidhidhanadhānyasamṛddhaśca sadā niṣkaṇṭako bhavetpañcaśuklotpalānyāni gṛhītvā pūrvavat kramātathavā pūrvavanmantrī pañcagavyena mantritamevaṃ ca pañcadurgāyā viniyoga udīritaḥsuvarṇaṃ labhate tadvadutpalaiḥ puṣṭimāpnuyātmadhvājyāktaiḥ sitaiḥ puṣpaiḥ sarvān kāmānavāpnuyātjaptvā'yutaṃ sahasraṃ vā mokṣaṃ gacchenna saṃśayaḥ

sanskrit: nyagrodhasamidho hutvā dhanadhānyamavāpnuyātaśvasthasamidho hutvā kāryamāśu ca sādhayetdurgāsthāneṣu navasu durgābījena śarkarāntato yāsyanti sahasā bhītāḥ sadyaḥ parasparamiṣṭasiddhirbhavatyāśu nātra kāryā vicāraṇāsamārabhya japenmantrī sadyaḥ sadyo vimucyatevilvairlakṣmīmavāpnoti śrīpuṣpaiśca tathaiva caādityamaṇḍalādagre yaḥ kṛtvā bhuvi vairiṇaḥjānudaghne jale tiṣṭhan dhyāyan vahnimayaṃ jalamripudehe viniḥkṣipya sahasraṃ krodhasaṃyutamprokṣaṇena jalasyaiva vairiṇaḥ kārayed vadhamdhyātaḥ śatrurvinaśyeta nātra kāryā vicāraṇāatidurgāmanuṃ prāhurdināstraṃ mantravittamāḥdināstrasya ṣaḍaṅgāni pratilomāditān viduḥmūlādutthitayā grastaṃ kuṇḍalyā bhāvayan sudhīḥdinatrayājjvarākrānto ripuḥ prāṇān vimuñcatipañcavāyusamiddhena vahninā dagdhavigrahammaṇipūragataṃ śatrumagninā dagdhavigrahamanāhatāhitaḥ śatrurnirdagdho mantravahnināviśuddhasthānago vairī dinabāṇena pīḍitaḥājñāyāṃ nihataṃ śatruṃ dahejjvālāgninā dhiyānābhimātrodake sthitvā dhyāyan bimbaṃ dineśituḥjapet saptadinādarvāk yamalokaṃ sa gacchatisūryodayaṃ samārabhya yāvadastamayo bhavetsthitvā durgālaye mantrī trirātraṃ varjitāśanaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00190 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: japenmanumimaṃ śatrurjvarito maraṇaṃ brajetśūlaprotaṃ nijaripuṃ dināstreṇa prapīḍitamravimaṇḍalagaṃ śatruṃ daṣṭaṃ tadrathapannagaiḥtarpayed dinabāṇena syādasau yamavallabhaḥripuṃ dhyātvā japenmantraṃ sa krīḍati yamāntikepratipadya nijaṃ śatruṃ prajapenmantravittamaḥpralayānalasaṃkāśāaṃ kālarātrimivāparāmsaviturmaṇḍalāntaḥsthāṃ raktanetratrayodgataiḥspaṣṭadraṃṣṭādharāṃ nṛtyadbhrukuṭīkuṭilānanāmdaṃṣṭrāmayūkhajvālena dyotayantīṃ digantaramjaped dinatrayaṃ mantrī mārayed ripumātmanaḥraktavastradharāṃ krūrāṃ raktanetratrayānvitāmkhaḍgena tacchiraśchittvā kṣaṇād vyomatalaṃ gatāmanenaiva vidhānena ripurmṛtyupriyo bhavetpaścimāmukhaliṅgasya sajīvaṃ mahiṣaṃ puraḥtasmin samedhite vahnau yathāvad deśikottamaḥajāraktena saṃsiktān kāraskarasamidvarānpralayāgnisamāṃ ghorāṃ dvātriṃśadbhujaśobhitāmmahādraṃṣṭrāṃ mahābhīmāṃ jvalatkeśīṃ nadanmukhīmanena vidhinā śatrurmahājvaraprapīḍitaḥurdhvamuṣṇāmbhasā mantrī lambayitvā bhujaṅgamamsahasrapāṇicaraṇāṃ sahasrākṣiśiromukhīmdhyāyenmūlena sarpāsye tarpayeduṣṇavāriṇāmadhyāhnārkāyutaprakhyāṃ nadantīṃ narasiṃhavatśūlaprotāhitāṃ dhyāyan japenmantramananyadhīḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00190 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yamasya bhavanaṃ gacchedarātirnātra saṃśayaḥuṣṇodake viniḥkṣipya viṣāḍhyo vidhinā tataḥnayanatrayanirgacchadvisphuliṅgaśatārgalāmkhaḍgakṛtyāhitāṃ dhyāyan prajapedayutaṃ manumprakalpya durgāyatane trikoṇaṃ kuṇḍamuttamamputtalīmajaraktāktāṃ pratiṣṭhitasamīraṇāmdhyātvā durgāṃ pranṛtyantīṃ mahiṣoraḥsthalāntareaṭṭahāsairajasrotthairbhīṣitāsurasainikāmsaṃdaṃṣṭrādharasaṃbhinnāṃ daṃṣṭrābhīmamukhāmbujāmanena vidhinā śatruḥ prayāti yamasannidhimsarvān kṛtyoditān kuryāt prayogānmantravittamaḥsuṣumnārandhramārgeṇa yātāṃ vyomasthalaṃ tataḥjvalatkālānalairdīptāṃ vicintya prajapenmanumaṅgāravāre citāgnau sarṣapasnehaloḍitamkṛtyāstrajvalayā dagdho ripuryamapuraṃ vrajetvraṇatailaviliptāni citāgnau juhuyāttataḥtuṣāsthinirmitāṃ śatrorvraṇatailapariplutāmchitvā chitvā'jaraktena saptāhānmriyate ripuḥvikirettāṃstaḍāgādau kṛtyāstrakvāthitaṃ jalamkṛṣṇāṅgāracaturdaśyāṃ prajaptaiḥ pretabhasmabhiḥnirmāya guṭikā etāḥ samyagjaptasamīraṇāḥcaturdaśītrayādarvāk śatrurmṛtyuvaśo bhavetmāhiṣe saṃsmared devīṃ kālāgnisadṛśaprabhāmdurgāgāre prajuhuyādanenāyutamantravitsā senā bahudhā bhinnā jvararogavimohitā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00190 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gehagrāmādiṣu kṣiptaṃ kuryāduccāṭanaṃ kṣaṇātsaptamāhendradigvajraṃ gṛhītvā prajapenmanumbhūyo japitvā vikired gehagrāmapureṣvimāḥbrahmadaṇḍī markaṭikāṃ karakrośanikātrayamcaturdaśyāṃ riporgehe musalaṃ prakṣipenmanumekaikaṃ vā khanenmantrī maṇḍalāttatphalaṃ labhetspṛṣṭvā tāṃ prajapenmantraṃ kṛṣṇāṣṭabhyāṃ niśārddhataḥkapālaphalakānmantrī kṛtyāstrākṣarasaṃkhyakānkṛṣṇāṅgāracaturdaśyāṃ śmaśāne viṣavṛkṣakeripuryamapuraṃ gacchenmahājvaravimohitaḥkapālena pidhāyainaṃ chādayed raktavāsasābhaumavāre niśāmadhye kāraskarasamedhitesādhyanakṣatravṛkṣeṇa kṛtvā kumbhaṃ prapūrayetjapapūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ yathāpūrvakamācaretayutaṃ vraṇatailena hutvānte taṃ ghaṭaṃ punaḥjuhuyād vidhinānena tridinānmriyate ripuḥpāyayenmahiṣīsarpiḥprasthaṃ mantreṇa mantritamkāraskaraidhite vahnau vraṇatailena mantravitekena divasenārirgacched yamapuraṃ tataḥarcite gandhapuṣpādyairayutaṃ juhuyāt kramātprasūtisamayaprāptāṃ mahiṣīṃ sthāpitānilāmmastakād yoniparyantaṃ dhiyā vatsamanusmaranevaṃ kṛte samutpannā kṛtyā dīptā hutāśanātpunaragnau viśatyeṣā kartāramapi rakṣiṇīsa japedātmarakṣārthaṃ mantrān mṛtyuñjayādikān
source_edition: Muktabodha M00190 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarvaśāntikaro mantro grahaṇādeva sidhyatichando'nuṣṭub mahārātrirbhadrakālī ca devatālavaṇādidvitīyādyā dahatyāḥ parikīrtitāḥaṅgirā munirākhyātaśchando'nuṣṭubudāhṛtamciṭimantrākṣaraiḥ kuryāt ṣaḍaṅgāni samāhitaḥpañcavarṇaiḥ śikhā proktā kavacaṃ karaṇākṣaraiḥtāraṃ ciṭidvayaṃ paścāccāṇḍāli tadanantaramvaśamānaya ṭhadvandvaṃ ciṭimantra udāhṛtaḥśruvaśaktivarābhayāni dorbhirdadhataṃ raktasaroruhe niṣaṇṇamkapālapāśāṅkaśaśūlahastāṃ nīlāmbarāṃ tāṃ yuvatīṃ namāmibhīmāṃ trinetrāṃ jitaśatruvargāṃ durgāṃ smared durgavibhaṅgadakṣāmpiṅgordhvakeśī sitadhūmanetrā bhūyād vibhūtyai mama bhadrakālīmahiṣīghṛtasiktena juhuyādedhite'naleagniyāmavatī dhyeyau vaśyākarṣaṇakarmaṇoḥjānupramāṇe salile sthitvā niśi japenmanumnābhimātrajale sthitvā japenmantramimaṃ sudhīḥṛkpañcakaṃ japenmantrī kaṇṭhamātrāmbhasi sthitaḥvilikhya tālapatre taṃ sādhyanāmavidarbhitamvaśyo bhavati sādhyo'sau nātra kāryā vicāraṇāvaśyāya sarvajantūnāṃ prayogo'yamudāhṛtaḥtāpayet khādire vahnau māsād vaśyo bhavennaraḥtasmin homaṃ prakurvīta saṃskṛte havyavāhanesaṃcūrṇitaṃ tu juhuyāt saptāhād vaśayejjanānvaśayet sakalān devānacirāt kimu pārthivānekaikayā prajuhuyād ṛcā pañcāhamādarāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00190 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śuddhaṃ lavaṇamādāya juhuyānmadhurānvitamnityaṃ śuddhena loṇena hutvā śatruṃ vaśaṃ nayetjuhuyād vaśayennārīrnarān narapatīnapiputtalīḥ pañca kurvīta sāṅgopāṅgāḥ samāḥ śubhāḥlavaṇaṃ potasaṃbhūtaṃ cūrṇitaṃ pariśodhitamguḍājyamadhubhiḥ samyag miśritenāmbunā tataḥprāṇamantraṃ kṛtaṃ yantramāsāṃ hṛdi vinikṣipetpaścāt kṛṣṇāṣṭamīrātrau yāmamātragate saticiṭimantrasamudbhūtān caturviṃśatisaṃkhyakānmūrdhni bhāle dṛśoḥ śrutyornāsāsyacibukeṣvapimeḍhre pāyau pravinyasya śiṣṭaṃ varṇacatuṣṭayamevaṃ vinyasya sarvāṅge raktamālyānulepanaḥadhomukhīṃ khanet kuṇḍe piṣṭajāmāsanādadhaḥmadhūcchiṣṭamayīṃ vyomni kuṇḍasyordhvaṃ pralambayetṛkpañcakaṃ yathānyāyamaṣṭottarasahasrakamaṅgulīsandhiprapadajaṅghorujānupāyuṣuagnimādāya saṃdīpya sādhyanakṣatradārubhiḥkusītarājipuṣpābhirdattvārghyaṃ praṇamet sudhīḥoṃ tvamanenāpyamitraghna niśāyāṃ havyavāhanajātavedo mahādeva taptajāmbūnadaprabhaoṃ īśe sarvābhiḥ sarvāṇi grastayuktaṃ tvayā jagatoṃ tamomayi mahādevi mahādevasya suvrateoṃ durge durgādirahite durgasaṃbodhanākuleoṃ namaste daha me śatruṃ vaśamānaya caṇḍikeoṃ bhadrakāli mahātīkṣṇe bhadrasiddhipradāyini
source_edition: Muktabodha M00190 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śūlāsiśaktivajrādyairutkṛtyotkṛtya mārayasādhyaṃ saṃskṛtya niṣpādya puttalīṃ saptadhā punaḥprathamo dakṣiṇaḥ pādastatkarastadanantarammadhyādūrdhvaṃ pañcamaḥ syādardhoṃ'śaḥ ṣaṣṭha īritaḥsaptasaptavibhāgo vā prokteṣveṣu yathāvidhiyajamāno dhanairdhānyaiḥ pūjayed gurumātmanaḥkiṃ punarmanujān bhūpān nāmādyānnarayoṣitaḥniveśayed yathā pūrvaṃ sādhako vidhinā tataḥvārāhapārāvataviṭtilakāṣṭhatryuṣaṇarāmaṭhaiḥmahiṣīmūtrasaṃpiṣṭaiḥ pūrvoktairlavaṇānvitaiḥjapapūjādikaṃ kuryāt prāguvartmanā tataḥdurgāṃ vā bhadrakālīṃ vā samabhyarcya yathāvidhivāmapādaṃ samārabhya dakṣiṇāṅghryavasānakamkṛṣṇāṣṭamīṃ samārabhya yāvat kṛṣṇacaturdaśītriḥsaptāhaprayogeṇa mārayed ripumātmanaḥvāruṇo varuṇā nāma ṛṣiḥ sañcalanaḥ svayamjānudaghne jale sthitvā rajanyāṃ dhyānamāsthitaḥraktapuṣpaiḥ samārādhya bhadrakālīṃ spṛśan japantālapatre likhenmantraṃ sādhyanāmavidarbhitamsa dāsavad bhavettasya yāvajjīvaṃ na saṃśayaḥprāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā juhuyāt sumanā bhuvisādhyavṛkṣamaye pīṭhe samāsīno parāsanepadmapuṣpaṃ paristīrya kuśaiḥ śaramayairapiraktavastreṇa lavaṇaiḥ kuryācca pratimāṃ śubhāmakṣarāṇi nyasettatra mantrasyātha vicakṣaṇaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00190 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tāvadādāya tenaiva saṃskṛtena kareṇa tujuhuyāt saptabhirmantrī saptadhā dhyānamāsthitaḥhomānte balidānaṃ tu nityaṃ kuryādvijānatākrameṇa nikṣiped bhūmau dvistrirvā sādhakottamaḥdattvā baliṃ japed bhūyo lavaṇādimanuṃ budhaḥśeṣaṃ samāpayed vidvān sa sadyo vaśameṣyatihomānte dakṣiṇāṃ bhūmiṃ hiraṇyaṃ vā yathāvidhiyastvevaṃ kurute homaṃ guruśāstropadeśataḥtathākarṣaṇamicchaṃstu nābhimātrajale sthitaḥdhyāyennityaṃ mahāratrau japenmantramatandritaḥjvālāmālapratīkāśāṃ mahārātriṃ mahābhujāmbhadrakālīṃ samārādhya gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ kramātdhyāyennaraṃ mahādevīṃ sa sadyastvāgamiṣyatikṣīramiśrajale kṣiptvā kvāthayed dhyānamāsthitaḥsāṅkuśapāśasaśūlakapālagrāmavatī bhavato'vatu nityampavanasakhanibhāṅgī pātu kātyāyanī vaḥbhavasiddhaye bhavatu bhadrakālī ciramdadhatī daṃṣṭrogrā dhyeyā trinayanavirājitātilatailaṃ vimiśritya hutvā śrīmān bhaviṣyatimātuluṅgaphalenaiva sarvaśāntirbhaved dhruvamnimbatailena yuktena lavaṇenāśu māraṇamkāraskarotthadhātrī syādudumbarataruḥ punaḥnāgarohiṇanāmānau palāśaplakṣasaṃjñakaubakulaḥ saralaḥ sarjo vañjulaḥ panasārkakauātmarakṣādikaṃ sarvaṃ kuryānmantrī yathā purā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00190 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sadṛśo nāsti mantro'nyaḥ satyameva na cānyathāparakṛtyāpraṇāśātmarakṣāṃ kurvan daśadikṣu baliṃ harenmantrairetaiḥnāśayatu mārayatu baliṃ tasmai prayacchatume īśagato yo me ūrdhvagato yo me divigato yo me pātakeneha karmaṇākalāvevaṃ kṛte'rīṇāmāśu kṛtyā vinaśyatigṛhadhūmacitāṅgārau māraṇeṣu viṣāṇi cagṛhadhūmastrikaṭukaṃ viṣāṣṭakamudīritamyaiḥ sādhayanti satataṃ mantriṇo nijavāñchitamyantraṃ hutāśānilavarṇapītamdhūmāvatī smṛtā kālī śatrunigrahakārikāśmaśāne nikhanedetacchatrumuccāṭayed dhruvamṣaṭkoṇasya dhū/ dhūmāvati svāhā iti likhetsvāhā ca trikoṇe tadbahiḥ ṣaṭbindulāñchitaṃ mātariśvanaḥ | iti vāyugṛhamyantraṃ prāntaparetabhūminihitaṃ vidveṣaṇaṃ syād dviṣāmghore vidveṣakāriṇi vidveṣodvegakāriṇividveṣayadvayaṃ hu/ phaṭ vidyā gharmaṭikeritāṣaḍbindulāñchitaṃ vāyugṛha tribhirveṣṭayetśūlodyaddvādaśārṇaṃ vidhivadabhihitaṃ pretarājasya mantramukto dhūmāndhakārāya svāhetyaṣṭākṣaro manuḥānanāya vadhūrvahnermantro'yaṃ dvādaśākṣaraḥālikhyāṣṭaviṣairetat śmaśāne nikhanenniśiripurgacchati pakṣeṇa yamalokaṃ na saṃśayaḥśūlacatuṣṭaye śūlasya prathamaśūlād daṃṣṭrāmantraṃ likhetstadvāhye yamabījamagnipavanābījañca yantraṃ likhetmāmodeta tademomā rakṣa tattatkṛtakṣaraḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00190 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yamā pāṭa ṭamā māya māṭa moṭa ṭamo ṭamāyamātmako'yamākhyātaḥ śloko vairivināśanaḥnigrahākhyamidaṃ yantraṃ kākapakṣeṇa karpaṭedakṣiṇasthe'nile mantrī nikhanedardharātrikenigṛhyate mahārogaiḥ patito vā bhavedayammarkaṭīviṣadaṇḍībhiḥ samāliptamadhomukhamūrdhvādho daśarekhābhistiryagrekhāstathā daśaṭaṭavīstvaṭavīṭaṭa ityuttara iti likhitvā vṛttaṃ dattvā tadbāhye vahnipavanābhyāṃ veṣṭayetkṛśānuvāyubījavṛtaṃ yantramidaṃ vidadhyātkramotkramācchatāvṛttyā tasya siddho bhavenmanuḥrāḍhyāṃ yauvanagarvitāṃ lipitanuṃ vāgīśvarīmāśrayeantyamādyaṃ dvitīyañca caturthaṃ madhyamaṃ kramāteṣā bhūtalipiḥ proktā dvicatvāriṃśadakṣaraiḥjñānavijñānasampanno bhavet siddho na saṃśayaḥevaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivad japan bhūtalipiṃ naraḥanayā saṃpuṭīkṛtya yo'muṃ mantraṃ japennaraḥpāśāṅkuśapuṭāśaktirvāṇībinduvibhūṣitāḥtadante haṃsamantraḥ syāt tato'muṣyapadaṃ bhavetamuṣya jīva iha ca sthito'muṣyapadaṃ bhavettiṣṭhantvagnivadhūrante prāṇamantro'yamīritaḥprayogeṣu samākhyātaḥ prāṇākarṣī mahāmauḥjananaṃ jīvanaṃ paścāt tāḍanaṃ bodhanaṃ tathātarpaṇaṃ dīpanaṃ guptirdaśaitā mantrasaṃskriyāḥmantrāṇāṃ mātṛkāmadhyāduddhāro jananaṃ smṛtametajjīvanamityāhurmantratantraviśāradāḥ

sanskrit: pratyekaṃ vāyunā mantrī tāḍanaṃ tadudāhṛtamtanmantrākṣarasaṃkhyātairhanyād yatnena bodhanamaśvatthapallavairmantramabhiṣiñced viśuddhayejyotirmantreṇa vidhivad dahenmantrī malatrayammantreṇa variṇā mantrī tarpaṇaṃ tarpaṇaṃ smṛtamjapyamānasya mantrasya gopanaṃ tvaprakāśanamyān kṛtvā sampradāyena mantrī vāñchitamāpnuyātkarṣamātraṃ ghṛtaṃ home śuktimātraṃ payaḥ smṛtamtatsamaṃ madhu dugdhañca yavamātramudāhṛtampṛthukāstatsamānāḥ syuḥ saktavo'pi tathoditāḥekaikaṃ patrapuṣpādi tathā dhūpādi kalpayetmātuluṅgaṃ catuḥkhaṇḍaṃ panasaṃ daśadhā smṛtamtridhākṛtaṃ phalaṃ vilvaṃ kapitthaṃ khaṇḍitaṃ dvidhāphalānyanyāni khaṇḍāni samidhaḥ syurdaśāṅgulāḥvrīhayo muṣṭimātrāḥ syurmudgā māṣā yavā apigodhūmā raktakalamā vihitā muṣṭimānataḥśuktipramāṇaṃ lavaṇaṃ marīcānyapi viṃśatiḥcandanāgurukarpūrakastūrīkuṅkumāni caanukte tu havirdravye tilājyaṃ havirucyateāyuḥ śādbalapallavaiḥ saha guḍaiḥ śāntiṃ sahājyaistilaiḥprītiṃ guḍena patraiḥ putrān saukhyaṃ phalairmanujaḥpuṣpairmālatyāḥ siddhagandharvalokānrvaiśyā nākiṃ kirātairgaṇa iva vaśagāḥ pāṭalābhiśca śūdrāḥatha vairibalaṃ parāṅmukhaṃ syānmadhurāktena mahāpalalena vāpikaṭutailavimiśritaiśca homādarayastrimunivāsarānmriyante

sanskrit: saptadināt pratipakṣanṛpāṇāṃ stambhanakṛt prabalasya balasyaunmattasya vṛkṣajābhiḥ samidbhirmṛtyuḥ saptāhāt śālmalīvṛkṣajābhiḥpalāśadrumakāṣṭhaiḥ parijvālya havyāśanaṃ candanābhyukṣitairbandhujīvaiḥnaro bhakṣyabhojyānnapānāni hutvā parāṃ sampadaṃ prāpnuyādatra lokekāmyatāṃ mallikābhiryaśaḥ syātkumudairjanavātsalyaṃ putrāḥ mallikusumaiḥ syuḥtatsakalaṃ madhuratrayahomāt syādacireṇa svaśaktimupetumgajāṅgulonnatiradhamā tilodbhavaṃ tathaiva mākṣikamapi pañcagavyayukekaikāpūpanikarapāyasamakṣapramāṇañcapanasaṃ daśakhaṇḍaṃ guḍakhaṇḍaṃ syātphalaṃ vailvamsarvaśāntimavāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇākādivarṇān saptasaṃkhyānīśāne lakṣamityapihastau kukṣī ca pādau dvau śiṣṭaṃ pucchamudāhṛtamduḥkhaṃ caraṇayoḥ pīḍā pucche kūrmatanorjapātsaptaplutaṃ tribhiḥ śiṣṭamṛṇaṃ tyājyaṃ dhanātmakamtribhiḥ plutaṃ saptaśiṣṭaṃ svagrāhyamīdṛśātmakamsapiṇḍākṣaramantrāṇāṃ arimitraṃ na cārcayetsvapnalabdhe striyā datte mitrāmitraṃ na cārcayetdvāraśāre akaḍame jijñāsānnasamantrayoḥsusiddhastrisaptake rudre dvādaśāṣṭacaturṣvariḥcakre'kathaha ityuktaḥ siddhādau nāmavarṇayoḥaṭṭahāsaṃ mahāraudraṃ pratyālīḍhaṃ mahāprabhamviṣādikrodhavajrāstraṃ krodharājamahāmanumnāśayeti padaṃ coktvā pāśaṃ krodhāstrasaṃyutamsarvabhūtān tataḥ kūrcamastrānte bhūtamāraṇam

sanskrit: kālakalpataruṃ natvā bhūtinīsiddhirucyatetāriṇī siṃhinī cātho haṃsinī ca tato naṭīkrodhāstradvayanāmānte bhūtavīryastrikūrcataḥkrodhadvayaṃ tu mantro'yaṃ vibhūṣiṇyā udāhṛtaḥyasyāḥ keśakulākulākhilamahī śailāntamārakṣatujapedaṣṭasahasraṃ tu dhyāyannekāgramānasaḥprajapedardharātre tu samāyāti vibhūṣiṇīmātā vā bhaginī bhāryā tuṣṭā bhavati kāmitāśatāṣṭaparivārasya dadātyañjanabhūṣaṇamdadāti striyamānīya divyaṃ rasarasāyanamdīnārāṇāṃ sahasraṃ tu rasaṃ caiva rasāyanamdhruvamāyāstradvayataḥ proktā kuṇḍaladhāriṇīpāyātkuṇḍaladhāriṇī trijagatāmānandasandohabhūḥāyāti rudhireṇārghyo deyastuṣṭo dadātyapipañcaśatavāsarāṇi trailokyamapi dāsyatikūrcatrayāstrasaṃproktaḥ sindūrahāriṇīmanuḥpāyād vallabhamūlarāhulatikā sindūrahāriṇyasauśīghramāyātyāgatā sā bhāryā bhavati kāmitārakṣati dvādaśajanān devī sindūrahāriṇīkrodhabījatrayājjātaḥ kīrtitaḥ siṃhinīmanuḥseyaṃ pātu samastamastakakulavyālambimālākulātato hṛṣṭā'tivaradā siṃhinyāyāti pūjitādīnāraṃ vastrayugalaṃ dadhad rasarasāyanamtrikūrcāstraṃ ca kathito haṃsi(nī)manuruttamaḥmuktāyuktavilolahāralatikā śrīhaṃsinī pātu vaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00190 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: hayamāreṇa saṃpūjya japedayutasaṃkhyakamcandanārghyapradānena hṛṣṭā vadati sādhakamvastrālaṅkārabhojyādi vyayārthaṃ saṃprayacchatitāraṃ krodhāstrayugato naṭītipadamuddharetyatprasādaṃ naro labdhvā sarvavāñchitamāpnuyātkūrcatrayalajjānto'yaṃ kathito nartakīmanuḥcandrodyatsunakhādinīṃ maṇikulavyāhārakārottarāmkṛtvārkāstamane dhūpaṃ candanena japedapisuvarṇapalamekaṃ tu vyayārthaṃ tyajya gacchatitārakūrcadvayaṃ cāstradvayaṃ ceṭī tataḥ paramkiñcid vakrasamācitāpi kabarī pāyācciraṃ ceṭikādhruvaṃ ceṭi samāgatya ceṭīkarma karotyapiāgatya nilayaṃ devī ceṭīkarma karoti sāante krodhadvayaṃ kāmeśvarīmantra udāhṛtaḥpāyāt puṣpadhanurdharā madhumukhī kāmeśvarī bhūtinīmāṃsādīni baliṃ dattvā sahasraṃ saptavāsarānkāmeśvarī bhavettuṣṭā bhāryā bhavati kāmitākrodhadvayastrayuk kāmeśvarītantroktavat kriyābhrāmyad raktotpalābhā sakalasuranatā divyabhūṣāṅgahārāante krodhadvayaṃ gṛhya devīmantramanuttamamsarvālaṅkārasaṃyuktā bhāryā bhavati kāmitāsitavastraṃ candanañca jātīpuṣpaṃ pradāpayetjapānte niyatāyāti cumbanāliṅganādibhiḥdadātyaṣṭau dinānyante divyaṃ vastrayugaṃ tataḥanyacca vaiśravaṇagṛhād dravyamānīya yacchati
